title: Marvelous Designer to UE 5.5 Import Issue with USD
content:
I've been trying to import from MV to UE5 and I'm getting an issue where parts of the clothing can see through to other parts of the clothing. I'm not sure what the issue is. I've played with the thickness values and export settings and have made sure the UV's are correct, but something about the material is not clicking together.  
  
My clothing mesh looks fine when I take off the material, or even when i use a basic material, but when I add it back on I can see through it again. Something tells me it's something to do with this USDImportTransluscentMaterial Material Parent, but I'm really not one to say  
  
I saw others having this issue too, and posts saying that it happens to some people and not others.  
  
I've also tried switching between directx 11 & 12, scaleable and maximum project settings, and also did the Enable Order Independent Transparency, but nothing really had any effect.  
  


![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/e0a7e741a0414538b2b04fb4b9b3acc9/images/2dc990b6032349cbaec853e0d34868751.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/e0a7e741a0414538b2b04fb4b9b3acc9/images/ce791ea6f7cd4071b1cc7c385163af982.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/e0a7e741a0414538b2b04fb4b9b3acc9/images/7d45e9767a984767b69f6ba508f25c663.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/e0a7e741a0414538b2b04fb4b9b3acc9/images/95eaab779a0c4ba2adc9ba0e6958cbe14.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/e0a7e741a0414538b2b04fb4b9b3acc9/images/3814a95300774cbc9120f0b467c4c1e35.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/e0a7e741a0414538b2b04fb4b9b3acc9/images/1de7378c5acb44fc9e7e5dea7014895a6.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/e0a7e741a0414538b2b04fb4b9b3acc9/images/11d8766e74124b9fb36d7c5ad23e24467.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/e0a7e741a0414538b2b04fb4b9b3acc9/images/8a717d6913b4475c81ecd12b838b69c08.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/e0a7e741a0414538b2b04fb4b9b3acc9/images/aed16ab077254baa88df9ea0a2f152d59.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/e0a7e741a0414538b2b04fb4b9b3acc9/images/75aad8d10664447fadbd0245ebb8b53b10.jpeg)


### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: hello . i am having the same issue in U.E 5.7 too! where you able to find a solution?

Comment 2: When working with Marvelous Designer, if you don't insert the Map Material, and only changed the color, Unreal Engine displays it as translucent as above. Try inserting the Material that contains the Image Map.You can solve this problem by using only the color as ConstantVector3 in the Blueprint of the Unreal Engine.
